run_nms_rotated_tests: run the unittest test suite for rotated NMS on CPU and CUDA devices
test_batched_nms_rotated: test batched_nms_rotated against horizontal batched_nms with 0 degree rotation on CPU
test_nms_rotated_angles: test nms_rotated at 0, 90, and 180 degrees against a reference horizontal NMS implementation
test_nms_scriptable: test that nms_rotated can be compiled with torch.jit.script on CPU and CUDA
review_nms_edit_distance: review the nms_edit_distance function that compares two NMS keep results using dynamic programming
